title: Year 11 Physics Module 2 – Dynamics
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Physics Module 2. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.prompt: What SI unit is used for force?
What term means the overall force after all forces on an object are combined?
What contact force opposes relative motion between surfaces?
What support force acts perpendicular to a surface?
What name is given to the gravitational force acting on an object?
Which Newton’s Law is also called the law of inertia?
Which Newton’s Law is summarised by Fnet = ma?
Which Newton’s Law describes equal and opposite force pairs?
If the net force on an object is zero, what can its velocity be?
questions.answer: Constant. Accept: zero or constant velocity.

questions.prompt: Do the two forces in a Newton’s Third Law pair act on the same object or different objects?
What quantity is calculated using mass multiplied by velocity?
What is the SI unit for momentum?
questions.answer: kg m/s. Accept: kg m s⁻¹.

questions.prompt: What quantity equals the change in momentum of an object?
On a force–time graph, what does the area under the graph represent?
In a closed system, what quantity is conserved during an interaction?
What type of energy does a moving object have?
What type of energy can an object have because of its position in a gravitational field?
What term describes energy transferred when a force causes displacement?
What quantity measures the rate of doing work or transferring energy?
What is the sum of an object’s kinetic and potential energy called?
In what type of collision is kinetic energy conserved?
In what type of collision is kinetic energy not conserved?
What type of collision occurs when objects stick together after impact?
For the same change in momentum, increasing collision time has what effect on average force?
questions.answer: It decreases the average force. Accept: decreases.

questions.prompt: What vehicle safety device increases stopping time by inflating during a collision?

finalRound.prompt: During a collision in a closed system, what total quantity remains constant even if kinetic energy changes?
